sentences.en: I love old films and my family loves them, too.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢老电影，我们家人也喜欢。

sentences.en: My mum and dad always talk about a really old film called Swiss Family Robinson, also a book, about a Swiss family who find themselves on a desert island when their boat sinks.
sentences.zh: 我爸妈总会说起一部很老的电影，叫《瑞士家庭鲁滨逊》，它也是一本书，讲的是一家瑞士人在船沉后发现自己被困在荒岛上。

sentences.en: And do you know what?
sentences.zh: 而且你知道怎么回事吗？

sentences.en: I like it, too.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢它！

sentences.en: So guys – here’s today’s topic.
sentences.zh: 所以各位，今天就聊这个话题。

sentences.en: Old films about families.
sentences.zh: 关于家庭的老电影。

sentences.en: So you know my opinion, what about yours?
sentences.zh: 你们知道我的看法了，那你们呢？

sentences.en: How about the Home Alone films in the 1990s, all about 8-year-old Kevin McCallister?
sentences.zh: 1990 年代的《小鬼当家》系列电影怎么样？讲的是 8 岁的凯文·麦卡利斯特。

sentences.en: The first one is definitely the best.
sentences.zh: 第一部绝对是最好的。

sentences.en: Kevin’s parents forget to take him on the family Christmas holiday.
sentences.zh: 凯文的父母忘了带他去参加家庭圣诞度假。

sentences.en: Kevin is happy at first because he’s got the whole house to himself and his brothers and sisters aren’t there to annoy him.
sentences.zh: 一开始凯文很高兴，因为整栋房子都属于他，兄弟姐妹也不在，没人烦他。

sentences.en: He has lots of fun stopping two silly criminals from robbing the family home.
sentences.zh: 他玩得很开心，阻止了两个愚蠢的窃贼抢劫自己家。

sentences.en: But he starts to miss his family and on Christmas morning he gets the best present of all – everyone comes back home!
sentences.zh: 但他开始想念家人，圣诞节早晨，他收到了最棒的礼物——大家都回家了！

sentences.en: It was funny then and it’s still funny now.
sentences.zh: 那时很好笑，现在依然很好笑。

sentences.en: Whose favourite family is the Parrs in The Incredibles?
sentences.zh: 谁最喜欢的家庭是《超人总动员》里的帕尔一家？

sentences.en: Remember them?
sentences.zh: 还记得他们吗？

sentences.en: The Parrs are like most families.
sentences.zh: 帕尔一家和大多数家庭一样。

sentences.en: You know, they fight and argue and have fun.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们会打闹、争吵，也玩得很开心。

sentences.en: But they’re also a family of superheroes.
sentences.zh: 不过他们也是一个超级英雄家庭。

sentences.en: Dad is super strong.
sentences.zh: 爸爸超级强壮。

sentences.en: Mum is super stretchy.
sentences.zh: 妈妈超级有弹性。

sentences.en: Violet, their eldest child, can turn invisible, and then nobody can see her.
sentences.zh: 他们的大女儿维奥莱特能隐身，那样谁也看不见她。

sentences.en: Her younger brother Dash is super fast and her baby brother Jack-Jack has laser eyes.
sentences.zh: 她弟弟达什快得像风，小弟弟杰克-杰克有激光眼。

sentences.en: I think those films are great, old or not.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那些电影很棒，不管老不老。

sentences.en: I like your comments, Max and Emma.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢马克斯和艾玛的评论。

sentences.en: And here is mine.
sentences.zh: 下面说说我的。

sentences.en: The Addams Family!
sentences.zh: 《亚当斯一家》！

sentences.en: They’re a really strange family who live in a normal town.
sentences.zh: 他们是个非常古怪的家庭，住在一个普通小镇上。

sentences.en: They all wear black.
sentences.zh: 他们全都穿黑衣服。

sentences.en: They live in a huge old house.
sentences.zh: 他们住在一栋巨大的老房子里。

sentences.en: Other families think they’re a little bit scary, but the Addams family don’t care.
sentences.zh: 别的家庭觉得他们有点吓人，可亚当斯一家并不在意。

sentences.en: The parents, Gomez and Morticia, and their children, Wednesday and Pugsley, are happy being different.
sentences.zh: 父母戈麦斯和莫蒂西亚，还有孩子星期三和帕格斯利，都很高兴能与众不同。

sentences.en: And there’s Cousin It, too.
sentences.zh: 还有表亲伊特。

sentences.en: He (or she – no one is sure) is covered in fur.
sentences.zh: 他（或者她——没人确定）全身长毛。

sentences.en: And finally there is Uncle Fester, Gomez’s brother.
sentences.zh: 最后是费斯特叔叔，戈麦斯的弟弟。

sentences.en: They’re one of the best loved screen families of all time – in my house, anyway!
sentences.zh: 他们是有史以来最受喜爱的荧幕家庭之一——至少在我家是这样！
